scope: Read-only, fully paginated direct relations on the two requested primary-space Page entities; schema lookup for Avatar and image properties.

comparableSchemaEvidence.note: The existing Zen Book has both Cover and Avatar relations, confirming that Avatar is a separate relation and Cover must not be substituted.

query: query($id: UUID!, $after: Cursor) { entity(id: $id) { id name spaceIds relations(first: 50, after: $after) { nodes { id typeId fromEntityId toEntityId entityId toEntity { id name } entity { name values(first: 20) { nodes { propertyId text } } } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } } }
